integrity: Proof and reproducible standard-library checker supplied, no independent mathematical or priority validation; publication priority and generality remain subject to external review.
scientific_limitations: Results concern the fixed-parameter asymptotic and finite-rank polynomial-exponential Laguerre Hankel operators. The 2016 structured-Hankel paper was not accessible beyond its abstract; historical equivalence is an unresolved risk. Finite checker evidence is diagnostic rather than a proof of limiting statements.
title: Spectral gap closure and an exponentially small edge state in finite-rank Laguerre Hankel operators
